stem: Which statement explains one of the motivations behind Manifest Destiny?

options.label: A
options.text: "These are the times that try men's souls: the summer soldier and the sunshine patriot will, in this crisis, shrink from the service of his country. . . ."

options.label: B
options.text: "I do order and declare that all persons held as slaves within said designated States, and parts of States, are, and henceforward shall be free. . . ."

options.label: C
options.text: "And that claim is by the right . . . to overspread and to possess the whole of the continent which Providence has given us. . . ."

options.label: D
options.text: "That it is the duty of the women of this country to secure to themselves their sacred right to the elective franchise."

visual_elements: Question text with four answer options labeled A-D
